claims_and_limits: The author-reported 11,858 concurrent sandboxes were tiny pods in a controlled scale test, not general capacity.
The preprint describes internal production model development and promises a future open-source release.
Containers share the host kernel; the authors do not claim malicious co-tenant isolation.
A real cancelled-create incident informed the lifecycle assessment, while the illustrated sequence is conceptual.

visual.shared_motif: Contained pods and a visible ownership/reconciliation path; separate horizontal cover and vertical lifecycle figure.
visual.status: Conceptual lifecycle illustration, not a literal Sandman architecture diagram.
